steps.description: Resolve the physical application root relative to ../install, load defaults and validate required source files.
Parse system|dev mode (system by default) and reject flags unavailable in the selected mode.
System uses --system-user/--system-group or USER_SYSTEM/USER_GROUP defaults. Dev without --clone-repo uses the invoker. Dev --clone-repo uses --user-system/--user-group or defaults.
System falls back to /opt, /etc/agents-system and /usr/local/bin. Dev resolves target and configuration from CLI, defaults and invoker or USER_SYSTEM home according to clone mode.
Require root, validate source and account contracts, and refuse unrelated existing targets even with --force.
Create a root-owned transactional journal before mutations.
Create or validate the application account and primary USER_GROUP. Prepare the shared access group named USER_SYSTEM and grant the application account membership.

System copies the system payload. Dev without --clone-repo copies no repository files and creates only an install-directory symlink to the current checkout. Dev --clone-repo copies the full repository exclusively to USER_SYSTEM_HOME/APP_NAME.

Render app_env.json first, then render agents-system.module.json from its MODULES_* values; publish both in package resources and APP_CONFIG_DIR. Preserve module methods, flags and exclusive groups and resolve each explicitly declared module directory.
Copy install/src to MODULES_DIR/install from the validated app_env.json, including per-operation help JSON files; journal replacement for rollback.
After app_env.json and the modules manifest are published to APP_CONFIG_DIR, run the installed internal_scripts/generate_configuration.sh with APP_ENV_PATH.

Create mode-specific durable and runtime directories with validated ownership. Then copy resources/agents-system.json atomically to INSTALLED_MODULES_DIR/agents-system.json from the rendered configuration and journal the mutation for rollback.
Publish asystem, asystem-uninstall, asystem-reinstall and asystem-reconfigure symlinks in the configured commands directory (system: /usr/local/bin).
Only system mode renders, verifies and installs the systemd unit; activation occurs after the environment pointer is written.
As the final filesystem mutation, write APP_DIR/src/.env with only ABSOLUTE_CONFIG_PATH from APP_ENV_PATH; only then enable and start the system runtime.

Verify installed resources, command links and optional service, then add the invoker to the USER_SYSTEM group as the final installation action. Shared directories use 2770, files 0660 and executables 0770.
Rollback journal-proven changes in reverse order after any failure.
Record successful outputs and retain the journal path for manual rollback.

actions: stop and disable only the service state introduced by this installation
restore the previous systemd unit and run daemon-reload when a backup exists
remove newly created command links and restore installer-owned previous links
restore backed-up configuration and application files
remove paths created by this installation after validating them against the journal
remove group membership added by this installation
remove a user or group only when the journal proves this installation created it
restore prior ownership, permissions and systemd activation state
record rollback completion and any item that could not be safely reverted
rollback.retention: Keep the journal after a successful install for manual rollback; it is temporary data under /tmp and may disappear after reboot or cleanup.

failure_policy: Validation or mutation failure stops installation and rolls back journal-proven changes. Without --force, existing targets stop installation. With --force, only targets proven to belong to this installation may be replaced.

implementation_layout.documentation_requirement: Public classes, non-obvious safety decisions, configuration resolution, side effects and rollback behavior must be documented. Create models or services only when they own a distinct responsibility.

description: Instaluje Agents System i publikuje komendy lifecycle.
